The script at `out/T3/solution.py` casts the 64 projection matrices to bfloat16 via an anchored regex, upcasts everything else to float32, drops the 48 buffers by exact name, and writes 9 shards plus the index file to `out/T3/`. One note: the two embedding matrices are 412 MB in float32, not the 206 MB quoted in the task, so each occupies its own shard as the rules require. The self-report is in `out/T3/REPORT.md`.
